purpose: Held-out test set. Evaluated once after all settings are frozen; never used for training, threshold picking, prompt or crop choices. Distribution-shifted from the training prompts.
how_to_use: Save clips as T01.mp4 … T60.mp4 in data/Test-Videos (id only); skip the ten with status 'dropped'.
Label blind in the label tool WITHOUT --suggest, and label what is visible, not the intended label.
Never pass data/Test-Videos to mcam-train, eval_probe.py or experiment scripts (build_dataset refuses it).
Run the final evaluation once; if settings change afterwards, the set is no longer clean.
